`bcn_weather_first_10_frames.mp3.base64` contains the first 7,680 bytes (ten
complete MPEG-1 Layer III frames) of `bcn_weather.mp3` from Hugging Face's
`hf-internal-testing/dummy-audio-samples` dataset. It is stored as base64 so
the fixture remains reviewable by text-only patch and source tooling.
